$comment: Tailzu is a voice keyboard for everyone, in dozens of languages, so this campaign uses Bauhaus, the root of the International Typographic Style: type as structure, one focal form, precise motion. Wada 313 light (Bauhaus-recommended): Yellow ground, Black type and bars at 15.93:1, Carmine for the one focal form (the full stop). Pairing schibsted (rated core by Bauhaus). No hand face: Bauhaus allows no handwriting.
